giga_train/distributed/ssh.py.name: paramiko.Transport
giga_train/distributed/ssh.py.note: SSH transport: a protocol client that always negotiates an encrypted session; counted by analogy with B2g (classes that always speak a secure protocol). Kind other because SSH is not TLS.

giga_train/distributed/ssh.py.name: transport.connect
giga_train/distributed/ssh.py.note: Runs the SSH key exchange and authentication on the transport; counted by analogy with B2j (handshake).

giga_train/distributed/ssh.py.name: paramiko.SSHClient
giga_train/distributed/ssh.py.note: SSH session client; counted by analogy with B2g. Hard call: here it only wraps the already connected transport.
